name: Mill End Store - Portland (Milwaukie)
old_description: Welcome to the Mill End Store! We are a family-owned fabric store located in Milwaukie, Oregon since 1918, and Beaverton, OR since the 1980s. Visit us and see over 50,000 sq. feet of unique fabrics, trims, & notions! We welcome all levels of quilters, crafters, sewists, seamstresses and everyone in between. We invite you to shop, share, and sew with us!
about:
Mill End Store operates from two locations in the Portland metropolitan area: its original Milwaukie, Oregon site opened in 1918 and a Beaverton branch added in the 1980s. The business has remained family-owned throughout its history, beginning as one of the West Coast’s first worsted wool mills that supplied military uniforms during both world wars and provided yarn for early Jantzen knitted swimwear.

Today the company functions as a specialty fabric retailer with more than 50,000 square feet of combined retail space stocking designer runs, one-of-a-kind fabrics, trims, and notions. Inventory turns daily, and the store fulfills orders by phone and mail for customers worldwide, supplemented by a swatch service and special-order program.

The customer base spans professional costumers for film and television, nationally recognized fashion designers, interior designers, quilters, crafters, and novice sewists. Shoppers regularly travel from across the country to visit the physical stores, which are open Tuesday through Saturday.

The company emphasizes its century-long continuity, knowledgeable staff with sewing expertise, and a reputation for carrying hard-to-find materials that draws a global clientele despite the absence of an online store.
